name: config_precedence_resolve
title: Resolve Config Precedence
prompt: Look under config/ and docs/. Merge layers with local > prod > defaults. Report API_TIMEOUT, RETRIES, and FEATURE_X on one single line as: API_TIMEOUT=N RETRIES=N FEATURE_X=value

docs/precedence.md: local overrides prod, prod overrides defaults.
Emit the three keys on ONE line separated by spaces (no newlines):
README.md: Service config overlays live in config/; merge rules are in docs/precedence.md.
Report API_TIMEOUT, RETRIES, and FEATURE_X only.
